summary: Fix confirmed for the epsilon case. For a Qwen3 model with rms_norm_eps 1e-3, the constructed Attention held norm_eps 1e-6 while its q_norm had rms_norm_eps 1e-3 at the affected commit c82af98d57c4 and the fix parent 965f5b2f0aa6: the configured head-norm epsilon was overwritten, and norm_eps is the value the fused decode routes pass to the native RMSNorm+RoPE call (attn.py lines 354/397/449 at the fix parent). At the fix a39fdfc4d5bd norm_eps was 1e-3, equal to q_norm. The model loaded and ran a finite forward pass at all three commits.
what_ran: repro.py writes a tiny random 1-layer Qwen3ForCausalLM (head_dim 64, q_norm/k_norm, rms_norm_eps 1e-3), builds it with Config.from_directory / Model.from_config, reads the Attention module's norm_eps / norm_constant_bias and its q_norm's settings, then loads it and runs one forward pass on physical GPU 1. Environment py312-superset-torch26cu126.
limits: Observed through the module's stored settings, not by a numerical comparison of fused output against a reference, so the size of the numerical effect is not measured. Only the epsilon case: no built-in model with nonzero head-norm constant bias (Gemma3) was constructed, so the bias half shows only 0.0 = 0.0.

model.repo_id: synthetic tiny Qwen3ForCausalLM generated by repro.py
